capabilities: Edit task dates, progress, dependencies and details in a Gantt chart
Reorder and nest tasks and groups, and filter by project stages
Open a chart in the current tab or beside a Markdown note
Add or postpone task dates and cycle priority from Markdown editor commands
Normalize task block IDs and tag placement on open or on save
extras: Desktop-only; interface available in English and Russian. HTML export exists only in the separate desktop application, and pop-out windows, mobile and use alongside arbitrary third-party plugins are unverified.
